notes.title: Major Bug Fix & Quality of Life Update
notes.content:
The new quality of life update let's you suffer without any pesky bugs.

Issues fixed:

- Endgame achievements not activating
- Hidden Temple not appearing / Achievement not activating
- Winnie-the-Pooh not appearing during last level / outro cutscene
- Spiders not respawning
- Out of bounds issues
- Spike collision issues
- Extreme FOV bug after dying
- Dialogue sometimes cutting off
- UI scaling issues on 4:3 resolutions

Do not disappoint Winnie-the-Pooh!
